args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Travel documents (ID, passport if needed, flight confirmations, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and extra batteries/memory cards
- Medications and first aid kit
- Reusable water bottle

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners and sightseeing
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Hat with brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins) - or plan to rent
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach bag
- Rash guard or swim shirt for sun protection

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking boots or sturdy shoes (for Diamond Head hike)
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Lightweight, quick-dry pants/shorts
- Long-sleeve lightweight shirt for sun/insect protection
- Small backpack for day hikes
- Insect repellent

EVENING ACTIVITIES:
- Luau-appropriate attire (aloha shirts, floral dresses)
- Slightly nicer outfit for dinner at restaurants
- Light sweater for air-conditioned venues

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Travel adapter if needed
- Books or e-reader for beach relaxation
- Travel-sized toiletries
- Hand sanitizer
- Small umbrella or rain jacket (for unexpected showers)
- Snacks for day trips

REMEMBER:
- Check luggage weight restrictions before packing
- Leave room in luggage for souvenirs
- Consider laundry options if staying for an extended period
